source_prompt: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a graceful ballerina in a sparkling pink tutu performing an extreme upside-down arabesque above a wooden pier at night. To the right, a black rat stands on its hind legs holding a large ornate perfume bottle under the warm glow of a flower-shaped lantern.
